Record Class OverrideResolver.ReferenceAdaptation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.sourcegen.generator.OverrideResolver.ReferenceAdaptation
Record Components:
argumentTypes - The type each value the functional interface passes is cast to, or null where it is passed as is
argumentConversions - The types each value is converted to before its argument type, the outer first: the raw bound of a variable, and the box of a primitive
resultType - The type the result is cast to, or null where it is returned as is
resultBound - The raw bound of a variable result type the result is converted to first, or null
Enclosing class:
OverrideResolver
public static record OverrideResolver.ReferenceAdaptation(List<@Nullable TypeDef> argumentTypes, List<List<TypeDef>> argumentConversions, @Nullable TypeDef resultType, @Nullable TypeDef resultBound) extends Record
The conversions a method reference to a narrowed method is written with.
Since:
2.3

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
